name: Mixed-use (6be5), Section 6, part evidence

observations.note: bldgs in good condition. structural inspection every 5 yrs by PE civil, report to BCA

planned preventive maint w some predictive. 3rd party LEWs. annual IR thermography LT boards, annual shutdown, PD test + DGA transformers, annual genset load test. no-load test monthly for one bldg, quarterly for another. genset maint programme needs improving
AHUs maintained by in-house contractors per manufacturer recommendation
FP impairment managed via isolation only. no formal impairment programme

service contract for FP equipment. monthly fire pump servicing, quarterly gaseous system, monthly water monitor + IR flame detectors, monthly smoke detector testing (100% annually), monthly fire roller shutter testing
8 gensets each w 1000L day tank, topped up manually at annual servicing. diesel licensed under SCDF. NaOH and sulphuric acid tanks in separate containment, auto pumped to neutralization tanks
housekeeping generally good in most areas
